citations.title: ONC Cures Act Final Rule: API certification criterion using FHIR Release 4
citations.what_it_says: Mandates FHIR R4 APIs for certified EHRs, creating federally enforced demand for FHIR-proficient developers at Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, and payers.

citations.title: 2023 HIMSS Health Informatics Workforce Survey
citations.what_it_says: Reports interoperability and FHIR-related roles among the fastest-growing informatics job categories, with salary premiums for credentialed interop specialists.

citations.title: HL7 FHIR Foundation and Proficiency certification program overview
citations.what_it_says: Per HL7 International's own program documentation (the standards body that authors and administers the credential), the FHIR Proficiency exam is offered as a low-cost, self-study assessment intended to signal baseline competency without requiring vendor sponsorship. Figures reflect HL7's published fee schedule at time of citation and should be re-verified against HL7's current program page.
